obligation: G090 -- the verify requires the head's share of TOKEN_NS measured FIRST

measured_inputs.note: ps/element from G072 measured on device; token from this session's short-context run

the_rising_floor: Today the head is 3.50% of the token. It does not shrink when the body does, so at planes k2 it becomes 4.07% and with a FREE body it is 10.62% of a 10.09 ms token. That limit token is 99.1 TPS, which is the ceiling density alone can reach and is itself the three-sided 100 TPS wall this campaign already recorded.
design_implication_BEFORE_choosing: The head is worth at most 1.071 ms. Halving its cost buys 0.54 ms, which is 1.8% of today's token and 5.3% of the density-limit token. That bounds every design in the acceptance list before any of them is built, and it says the head is a real but SMALL floor -- not the thing standing between this machine and 100 TPS.
